name: claim_default_reason
xsql:
SELECT Nvl(MAX(r.reason_code), '') AS reason_code
FROM   claim.claim_reason_code r
WHERE  r.is_active = 'Y'
  AND  r.sort_order = ( SELECT MIN(r2.sort_order)
                        FROM   claim.claim_reason_code r2
                        WHERE  r2.is_active = 'Y' )
